name: Pleo
summary: Pleo gives every employee a physical or virtual company card and adds approval workflows on its Build plan. Budgets and spending insights arrive on the Optimise plan. The US page lists Build at $14 and Optimise at $18 per user per month, billed yearly with a three-user minimum. Foreign exchange fees of 1.49% to 1.75% apply to card and invoice payments.

facts.text: Pleo's US features page says virtual cards are issued in seconds and that spend limits and multi-step approvals are available.
On the US pricing page, Build includes approval workflows and teams management, while budgets appear only on Optimise.
The US page lists direct reimbursements at 0.90% on both plans and free ATM withdrawals.
Pleo's US prepaid card is issued by Pathward N.A., Member FDIC.
The global pricing page shows a UK price list in pounds with a Start plan at 8 pounds per user per month, so the plans and prices differ by country.

plans.name: Build
plans.unit: per user per month, billed yearly, 3 users minimum
plans.notes: Approval workflows, teams management, physical and virtual cards. Foreign exchange fee 1.75% on card and invoice payments. Direct reimbursements 0.90%

plans.unit: per user per month, billed yearly, 3 users minimum
plans.notes: Everything in Build plus budgets and spending insights. Foreign exchange fee 1.49% on card and invoice payments. Direct reimbursements 0.90%

hiddenCosts: The US page links to Medium and Enterprise plans without showing prices.
Foreign exchange fees of 1.75% (Build) and 1.49% (Optimise) apply to card and invoice payments.
